title: Me and Te --- The Two People Talking
label: ch:pronoun-me-te
canDo: I can say te quiero and me quieres, and tell the doer form apart from the object form.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C42-te: produce te quiero and me quieres, and name the English pair that matches tu and te.
payoff.note: Exactly one new form. Me contributes a second use of a word held since chapter four, which is why both lessons fit one chapter without crowding it.
